title: Portal Selfie
description: A woman in a pink belly dancing outfit kneels on a patterned rug, taking a selfie with a smartphone while touching an ornate mirror. The mirror reveals a fleshy pink portal containing a blue demonic creature with horns and a smaller version of the woman inside.
prompt: A young woman in a revealing pink and black belly dancing costume with a headscarf kneels on an ornate rug in a pink-themed bedroom, taking a selfie with a glowing smartphone while her other hand touches a large gothic mirror frame. Inside the mirror is a surreal fleshy pink tunnel with floating flames and a blue demonic creature with horns reaching out, a smaller version of the woman visible deeper inside the portal, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting
